splitButton.$description: SplitButton's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--split-button-<name>) on the page, a container or one SplitButton, and every SplitButton inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

divider.$description: How strong the edge between two primary halves is: their text color at this opacity (40%).
